title: FBI-UAP-D040, FD-302, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record detailing two UAP sightings in the western United States in 2026, featuring heavy redactions of names and locations.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a red light at the crest of a mountain range, which appeared as a cluster of three lights in a triangular or diamond-shaped pattern.
incidents.quote: the lights appeared to each be three separate lights in a triangular or diamond-shaped pattern.

incidents.summary: Witness observed two lights on or near the ground using night observation devices, followed by a rapidly moving streak of light.
incidents.quote: witnessed two lights on or close to the ground to their east, which were only visible using NODs.
